description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for airborne microbial genome sequencing from urban air samples collected with high-volume air samplers across diverse urban environments.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air sample or sequenced aliquot; should be stable and unambiguous within the project.

study_id.descr: Optional project or study identifier linking the sample to a broader study design or campaign.

site_name.descr: Name of the sampling site or location, such as a park, industrial zone, or residential area.

site_type.descr: Controlled location category; examples include park, industrial_zone, residential_area, roadside, commercial_area, campus, or mixed_use.

urban_context.descr: Short descriptor of the surrounding urban setting or land-use context.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

administrative_area.descr: State, province, region, or equivalent administrative area of the sampling location.

city.descr: City or municipality where the sample was collected.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level, in meters.

collection_date.descr: Date when the air sample was collected.

collection_time.descr: Local time when sampling began or was recorded; recommended format HH:MM:SS.

time_of_day.descr: Categorical time window for collection, such as morning, afternoon, evening, or night.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Duration of air sampling in minutes.

sampled_air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled, in cubic meters.

sampler_type.descr: Type of air sampler used, for example high-volume air sampler, cyclone sampler, filter sampler, or impinger.

sampler_model.descr: Manufacturer/model name or identifier for the air sampling device.

flow_rate_m3_min.descr: Air flow rate during sampling, in cubic meters per minute.

filter_material.descr: Material of the collection filter or capture medium, such as PTFE, quartz fiber, or cellulose.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers, if applicable.

sample_height_m.descr: Height above ground at which the sampler inlet was positioned, in meters.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate identifier for technical or field replicates collected at the same site and time.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time, expressed as percent.

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time, in meters per second.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction in degrees clockwise from north.

precipitation_flag.descr: Indicates whether precipitation was occurring during sampling (true/false).

weather_condition.descr: General weather condition at sampling time, such as clear, cloudy, rainy, foggy, windy, or mixed.

air_quality_index.descr: Optional air quality index value measured at or near the sampling time, if available.

pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Fine particulate matter concentration (PM2.5), in micrograms per cubic meter, if available.

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration (PM10), in micrograms per cubic meter, if available.

proximity_to_green_space_m.descr: Distance from the sampling site to the nearest green space, in meters.

near_green_space.descr: Boolean indicator of whether the site is within a predefined distance threshold of green space.

green_space_type.descr: Type of nearby green space, such as park, urban forest, grassland, or street trees.

proximity_to_pollution_source_m.descr: Distance from the sampling site to the nearest identified pollution source, in meters.

near_pollution_source.descr: Boolean indicator of whether the site is within a predefined distance threshold of a pollution source.

pollution_source_type.descr: Type of nearby pollution source, such as traffic corridor, factory, power plant, waste facility, or construction site.

proximity_to_road_m.descr: Distance from the sampling site to the nearest major road, in meters.

indoor_outdoor.descr: Indicates whether the sample was collected outdoors, indoors, or in a semi-enclosed environment.

surface_cover_fraction_green.descr: Estimated fraction of surrounding area covered by vegetation within a defined buffer, expressed as a value from 0 to 1.

surface_cover_fraction_built.descr: Estimated fraction of surrounding area covered by built structures within a defined buffer, expressed as a value from 0 to 1.

human_activity_level.descr: Qualitative estimate of pedestrian or human activity near the sampling site, such as low, medium, or high.

sample_matrix.descr: Material collected from the sampler, such as air filter, impaction plate, liquid trap, or swab from sampler surface.

collection_protocol.descr: Free-text or controlled description of the sampling protocol used for collection and handling.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored prior to extraction, in degrees Celsius.

storage_duration_h.descr: Duration between sample collection and DNA extraction or processing, in hours.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for DNA extraction from the collected material.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation method or kit used before sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, such as Illumina, Oxford Nanopore, or PacBio.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Sequencing run or instrument run identifier.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequenced read length in base pairs, if applicable.

insert_size_bp.descr: Average library insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

target_amplicon_region.descr: If amplicon sequencing was used, the targeted marker region, such as 16S rRNA V3-V4 or ITS1.

primer_set.descr: Primer set used for amplicon sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for the sample.

quality_filtering_method.descr: Method used for read quality filtering and trimming.

assembly_method.descr: Method or software used for assembly of metagenomic reads, if applicable.

binning_method.descr: Method or software used for genome binning, if applicable.

taxonomic_annotation_db.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic classification or annotation, such as SILVA, GTDB, KrakenDB, or NCBI RefSeq.

functional_annotation_db.descr: Reference database used for functional annotation, if applicable.

dominant_taxa_note.descr: Optional note on dominant detected taxa or taxonomic signatures in the sample.

pathogen_screening_flag.descr: Indicates whether the sample was screened for known human, animal, or plant pathogens.

human_health_relevance_note.descr: Free-text note describing any observed or hypothesized human-health relevance, exposure concern, or epidemiological context.

biosafety_level.descr: Biosafety level or handling category associated with the sample processing workflow, if relevant.

quality_control_flag.descr: Indicates whether the sample passed predefined quality control criteria.

qc_notes.descr: Free-text notes describing quality control issues, contamination concerns, or exclusions.

associated_metadata_source.descr: Source of environmental metadata, such as on-site sensor, nearby weather station, remote sensing, or manual observation.

metadata_record_created_date.descr: Date when the metadata record was created or last curated.
